command:
set -euo pipefail
BR=$HOME/.claude/star/local_bridge_state/repo
SHA=3738f28441c946d78001ceacfec53aa21e75a77e
BRANCH=chatgpt-gpt56sol-avatar-depthwarp-remap-dtype-repair-20260912
EXPECTED_LIVE=18770d8e333af1bc49a818da4dbd5c2e482b859e0142d0213df6c956184c931e
git -C "$BR" fetch -q origin "refs/heads/$BRANCH:refs/remotes/origin/$BRANCH"
GOT=$(git -C "$BR" rev-parse "refs/remotes/origin/$BRANCH"); test "$GOT" = "$SHA" || { echo SUBJECT_DRIFT=$GOT; exit 42; }
TD=$(mktemp -d /tmp/depthwarp-repair-XXXXXX)
for f in depthwarp_display_space_gate.py depthwarp_blind_perceptual_gate.py test_depthwarp_remap_dtype.py; do git -C "$BR" show "$SHA:research_entity/avatar/tools/$f" > "$TD/$f"; done
PRE_LIVE=$(sha256sum buehne.html|awk '{print $1}'); test "$PRE_LIVE" = "$EXPECTED_LIVE"; PRE_DAEMON=$(sha256sum buehne_daemon.py|awk '{print $1}'); PRE_FILM=$(sha256sum filmlook.js|awk '{print $1}')
echo SUBJECT_SHA=$GOT LIVE_PRE=$PRE_LIVE DAEMON_PRE=$PRE_DAEMON FILMLOOK_PRE=$PRE_FILM
PYTHONPATH="$TD" python3 "$TD/test_depthwarp_remap_dtype.py"
OUT=.go_evidence/depthwarp_blind_perceptual_dtype_repair_20260912
rm -rf "$OUT"; mkdir -p "$OUT"
PYTHONPATH="$TD" python3 "$TD/depthwarp_blind_perceptual_gate.py" --visual-root /home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual --out "$OUT"
python3 - "$OUT/objective_report.json" "$OUT/blind_manifest.json" <<'PY'
import json,sys,hashlib,pathlib
r=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); m=json.load(open(sys.argv[2])); print('OBJECTIVE',json.dumps({'candidate_cases':r['candidate_cases'],'eligible_cases':r['eligible_cases'],'thresholds':r['thresholds'],'credit':r['credit']},sort_keys=True)); print('BLIND_CASES',m['case_count']); print('KINDS', {k:sum(c['kind']==k for c in m['cases']) for k in sorted({c['kind'] for c in m['cases']})});
for p in sys.argv[1:]: print('ARTIFACT_SHA',p,hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest())
PY
POST_LIVE=$(sha256sum buehne.html|awk '{print $1}'); POST_DAEMON=$(sha256sum buehne_daemon.py|awk '{print $1}'); POST_FILM=$(sha256sum filmlook.js|awk '{print $1}'); test "$POST_LIVE" = "$PRE_LIVE"; test "$POST_DAEMON" = "$PRE_DAEMON"; test "$POST_FILM" = "$PRE_FILM"; echo LIVE_POST=$POST_LIVE DAEMON_POST=$POST_DAEMON FILMLOOK_POST=$POST_FILM; echo DEPTHWARP_DTYPE_REPAIR_REALHOST=PASS
